newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Hainan sentences seven to death - agency.
newsitem.headline: China's Hainan sentences seven to death - agency.

text.p: China's southern Hainan province on Friday sentenced seven people to death for crimes ranging from murder to armed robbery, the semi-official China News Service said.
They were taken to the execution site immediately after the Haikou Intermediate People's Court handed down the sentences. But the report did not say if they were executed.
Executions in China are usually carried out right after sentencing.
